levels.2: passing isolated unit or differential tests
levels.4: verified against the original DOS executable in a stated domain (three-way, scenario level)

notes: Levels are the highest level reached inside the stated domain; a subsystem can be level 2 for isolated routines and still level 5 at scenario level. Both are given.

Scenario comparison is aligned at DoAntSim entries with the original run's seeding clock reads replayed (portable/tests/acceptance, time-align); non-seeding clock reads and input delivery are not yet aligned (worker clock-all).
